name: Cha Taeuk
source:
Top baseball player. He is an additional cast of House of Crush with sexy and powerful charms. He is full of confidence and can do anything he wants. He is one of the top baseball players in the country. He decided to participate when he was thinking about retiring due to his decreasing score performance. He had no expectations for the show, but there is one girl who makes him expect something more...
